subject: [PATCH v5 15/22] f2fs: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations for the F2FS file system to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using the DEFINE_IOMAP_ITER_NEXT() macro. This change does not introduce any functional changes and simply updates the existing code to conform to the new interface. The goal of this conversion is likely to prepare F2FS for future improvements or changes related to iomap operations.
